newsitem.title: SPAIN: Madrid stocks shift down a gear in thin trade.
newsitem.headline: Madrid stocks shift down a gear in thin trade.

text.p: MADRID, May 19 (Reuter) 1515 GMT - Madrid stocks ended lower on Monday in a continued round of profit-taking, although volumes were thin, dealers said.
The general index shed 2.05 points, 0.38 percent, to 541.86 and the Ibex-35 blue chip index fell 25.19 points, 0.4 percent, to 6,228.68
Most major stocks paused for breath but are expected to make further gains short term, dealers said. Telefonica shed 20 pesetas to 4,020 while Repsol dropped 10 pesetas to 5,990.
State holding Sepi announced global coordinators for the autumn privatisation of Endesa, and the stock rose 50 pesetas to 11,100.

But otherwise there was little in the way of fresh factors ahead of tomorrow's Federal Open Market Committee meeting on Tuesday, at which some are expecting a 25 basis point rate hike in the fed funds rate.
"It's been pretty quiet, with the market taking the opportunity for a well-deserved break as a lot of European countries are on holiday. But short term we'll see further gains," said a trader.
